title: Research
text:
My research focuses on variable selection and prediction with multistate processes under complex observation schemes. Applications includes identifying key risk factors from a large number of candidate variables.
My work includes both methodological contributions, where I develop statistical tools for multistate and survival data, and applied collaborations with clinician scientists to support clinical research. Feel free to check out my work on Google Scholar.

title: Xianwei Li
text:
Hi, I’m Xianwei Li - welcome to my page!
I recently completed my PhD in Statistics (Biostatistics) at the University of Waterloo.
My doctoral supervisors were Prof. Richard J. Cook and Prof. Liqun Diao.
My research focuses on variable selection and prediction for multistate processes, with applications in biomedical studies.

Mentoring

Mentor, Directed Reading Program (DRP), University of Waterloo
Jan 2024 – Apr 2025
Mentored three reading projects for undergraduate students focusing on statistics and machine learning:

Winter 2024 — Introduction to Survival Analysis

Fall 2024 — Introduction to Survival Analysis

Winter 2025 — Predictive Models in Healthcare

Each project included weekly meetings, guided reading, discussions, and individualized mentorship.
